runs.name: Herc Holdings Inc.; NYSE HRI, SEC CIK 0001364479, one of the leading equipment rental suppliers in North America, 602 locations, one reportable segment, through Herc Rentals Inc.; H&E Equipment Services bought 2025-06-02 for $78.75 in cash and 0.1287 Herc shares per H&E share; United Rentals and H&E the filing rivals the FY2024 10-K names, Sunbelt (Ashtead) flagged
runs.entry: Price **$121.28** (quote of 2026-10-16 printed by `tools/run.py`, aggregator, flagged). Shares **33,431,444**, one class (10-Q for the quarter to 2026-06-30, filed 2026-07-28, accession 0001364479-26-000109; checked against 38.3 million issued less 4.9 million in treasury; the two later 8-Ks, a receivables-facility amendment of 2026-09-03 and a director's election of 2026-08-19, issue no shares); cap **$4,054.6M**. Sovereign **5.43%** (US Treasury daily par yield curve, 30-year, 2026-10-15). Filings read: 10-K FY2025 (0001364479-26-000050), Items 1, 1A, 7, the statements and Notes; 10-Ks FY2024, FY2022, FY2019 and FY2016 for the earlier years and the named rivals; 10-Q Q2 2026; DEF 14A filed 2026-03-27 (0001364479-26-000076); 8-K 2026-07-28, cover only. Cross-check: 2025 operating cash $1,085M on the filed statement equals the tag. `tools/run.py`'s owner figure (non-rental capex only) and its D&A column (intangible amortization only) checked and set aside; owner cash rebuilt from the filed cash-flow statements, rental fleet spending charged and used-equipment proceeds credited. The brief departed in one stated place: six lines of evidence derived by the analyst from the 10-K's Items 1, 1A and 7, listed in the run file. **Resumed run**: the template was copied and committed by a first analyst (e2b320b4) whose session ended before any section was written; the second analyst resumed from the research folder. **Q1 IN**: one segment, a fungible fleet, about 4% of North American rental revenue, the drivers (fleet on rent, rate, fleet cost and resale value, cost of money) readable from its own and its rivals' filings. **Q2 OUT**: equipment rental a commodity-type field on the filer's own account (Item 1A: 'price is one of the primary competitive factors', customers able to shift suppliers quickly, rivals with lower fixed costs, suppliers renting direct), and Herc not the low-cost producer against United Rentals in any year 2017 to 2025: operating margin 13.4% mean against United Rentals 24.5% and H&E 13.7% (2017 to 2024), pre-tax return on average total assets 6.8% against 12.8% and 8.5%; the gap holds in Herc's best year (2023, 20.4% against 26.7%) and after removing the Cinelease losses. The FY2025 10-K names no rival; the FY2024 10-K's three used, Sunbelt flagged (one 10-Q on EDGAR). Q3 to Q12 not reached. Facts after the stop: assets $3.46B to $13.78B and debt $2.18B to $8.05B 2016 to 2025, goodwill and intangibles $395M to $4.54B, tangible equity -$2.59B; total debt $7,912M at 2026-06-30, cash interest $419M in 2025 against pre-tax income of $1M; dividends $87M in 2025 against net income of $1M and $47M in the first half of 2026 against a $5M loss; H&E bought for $4.8B plus $1.4B of its debt paid off, funded with notes, a term loan and the ABL; buybacks $115.2M (2022) and $120M (2023), prices not read. **Integrity facts recorded, not judged** (DEF 14A): the 2025 annual incentive moved from 90% financial to 30% financial; the 2025 REBITDA target $1,680.0M with the maximum set equal to the target, actual $1,679M scored 100%; the 2024 and 2025 PSUs amended and restated to annual goals in February 2026; target performance assumed for 2025 on the 2023 grant. Owner cash, 2021 to 2025 averages: all spending $69.1M after interest, $242.1M before; maintenance case (depreciation as the proxy) $333.1M after interest, $506.1M before; acquisitions $6.13B net over the window, so the central figure is on the organic pair. COMPUTATION, NOT A CLEARANCE: value **-$64.84 to $40.47** a share (central: organic pair, maintenance case, all-equity, less net debt of $7,967M) against $121.28; expected return 4.21% central on $12.02B paid for the business, 8.22% at best on equity alone, no case earns the floor; fair **-$111.67 all-equity** ($83.35 equity-only); not armed, the box being OUT at Q2. A CONVENTION of the run: interest added back on the all-equity basis at the 21% federal statutory rate, because Herc paid little cash tax. Contamination declared by the analyst: the opening commit subjects (another company's re-run result), a memory index line, the map's file names; none names HRI; none used. Commits e2b320b4, 172833d4 (Step 0 and Q1), b1578cb7 (Q2), 7d016aee (close). Position note filled at the fold: not held. Citations: the analyst's `check_ids.py` 36 ids, 19 quotes, no problem; the dispatcher's `dispatcher_cite_check.py` 36 ids, 17 quoted fragments, no missing id, no E-id, no slip. No tracked research file over 200 KB. check_framework PASS. **For the operator** (the analyst's framework notes): (1) Q2's commodity paragraph is written for dependence on a commodity price while the earlier section defines a commodity business by the customer's indifference, and the text does not say outright that the high-cost-producer OUT applies to the second kind; applied on [L2004-003] and [M1997-010]; (2) Q7 does not say how to add back interest on the all-equity basis when the company pays almost no cash tax; (3) specific (b)'s halves of a five-year window are undefined; (4) the serial-acquirer rule's 'organic growth as the filer reports it' when the filer reports it for one year only. Could not get: Sunbelt's full span; the rivals' figures re-read line by line (their tagged filed figures used); the earnings release body; the buyback prices; organic growth before 2025.
runs.narr: OUT at Q2 after Q1 IN (one segment, a fungible fleet, about 4% of North American rental revenue). Equipment rental a commodity-type field on the filer's own account, price a primary competitive factor and customers able to shift suppliers quickly, and Herc not the low-cost producer against United Rentals in any year 2017 to 2025: operating margin 13.4% mean against 24.5% (H&E 13.7%), pre-tax return on average total assets 6.8% against 12.8% (H&E 8.5%), the gap holding in Herc's best year and after the Cinelease losses; Sunbelt flagged. Facts after the stop: debt $7.9B, tangible equity -$2.59B after the H&E purchase, dividends paid against net income of $1M in 2025; integrity facts recorded, not judged: a 2025 bonus target with the maximum set equal to it, met at 100%, and the 2024 and 2025 PSUs restated to annual goals in February 2026. COMPUTATION beneath the stop: value -$64.84 to $40.47 all-equity against $121.28, 4.21% central, no case earning the floor; fair -$111.67 all-equity, $83.35 equity-only, not armed. Framework gaps for the operator: the commodity paragraph's two kinds of commodity business; the interest add-back when little cash tax is paid; specific (b)'s halves of a five-year window; organic growth reported for one year only.
